name: chime-sdk-identity
description: The Amazon Chime SDK Identity APIs in this section allow software developers to create and manage unique instances of their messaging applications.

subcommands.name: create-app-instance
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Chime SDK messaging AppInstance under an AWS account.

subcommands.name: create-app-instance-admin
subcommands.description: Promotes an AppInstanceUser or AppInstanceBot to an AppInstanceAdmin.

subcommands.name: create-app-instance-bot
subcommands.description: Creates a bot under an Amazon Chime AppInstance.

subcommands.name: create-app-instance-user
subcommands.description: Creates a user under an Amazon Chime AppInstance.

subcommands.name: delete-app-instance
subcommands.description: Deletes an AppInstance and all associated data asynchronously.

subcommands.name: delete-app-instance-admin
subcommands.description: Demotes an AppInstanceAdmin to an AppInstanceUser or AppInstanceBot.

subcommands.name: delete-app-instance-bot
subcommands.description: Deletes an AppInstanceBot.

subcommands.name: delete-app-instance-user
subcommands.description: Deletes an AppInstanceUser.

subcommands.name: deregister-app-instance-user-endpoint
subcommands.description: Deregisters an AppInstanceUserEndpoint.

subcommands.name: describe-app-instance
subcommands.description: Returns the full details of an AppInstance.

subcommands.name: describe-app-instance-admin
subcommands.description: Returns the full details of an AppInstanceAdmin.

subcommands.name: describe-app-instance-bot
subcommands.description: The AppInstanceBot's information.

subcommands.name: describe-app-instance-user
subcommands.description: Returns the full details of an AppInstanceUser.

subcommands.name: describe-app-instance-user-endpoint
subcommands.description: Returns the full details of an AppInstanceUserEndpoint.

subcommands.name: get-app-instance-retention-settings
subcommands.description: Gets the retention settings for an AppInstance.

subcommands.name: list-app-instance-admins
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the administrators in the AppInstance.

subcommands.name: list-app-instance-bots
subcommands.description: Lists all AppInstanceBots created under a single AppInstance.

subcommands.name: list-app-instance-user-endpoints
subcommands.description: Lists all the AppInstanceUserEndpoints created under a single AppInstanceUser.

subcommands.name: list-app-instance-users
subcommands.description: List all AppInstanceUsers created under a single AppInstance.

subcommands.name: list-app-instances
subcommands.description: Lists all Amazon Chime AppInstances created under a single AWS account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags applied to an Amazon Chime SDK identity resource.

subcommands.name: put-app-instance-retention-settings
subcommands.description: Sets the amount of time in days that a given AppInstance retains data.

subcommands.name: put-app-instance-user-expiration-settings
subcommands.description: Sets the number of days before the AppInstanceUser is automatically deleted.

subcommands.name: register-app-instance-user-endpoint
subcommands.description: Registers an endpoint under an Amazon Chime AppInstanceUser.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Applies the specified tags to the specified Amazon Chime SDK identity resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the specified Amazon Chime SDK identity resource.

subcommands.name: update-app-instance
subcommands.description: Updates AppInstance metadata.

subcommands.name: update-app-instance-bot
subcommands.description: Updates the name and metadata of an AppInstanceBot.

subcommands.name: update-app-instance-user
subcommands.description: Updates the details of an AppInstanceUser.

subcommands.name: update-app-instance-user-endpoint
subcommands.description: Updates the details of an AppInstanceUserEndpoint.
